description: This file implements the HealthcheckService class, which manages periodic health checks (pings) to servers, handles acknowledgments, and manages server state changes based on ping responses. It includes methods for starting/stopping timers, processing ping acknowledgments, and sending pings.

classes.name: HealthcheckService
classes.description: Manages health check pings to servers, handles responses, and updates server states accordingly.

methods.name: HealthcheckService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the health check timer if the interval is non-zero.

methods.name: ~HealthcheckService
methods.description: Destructor that cancels and resets the health check timer if active.

methods.name: onPingSent
methods.description: Handles the event when a ping is sent to a server, verifying ping ID and tracking pending pings.

methods.name: onAckReceived
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment from a server, verifying ping ID, removing from pending, and updating server state on failure.

methods.name: onServerRemoved
methods.description: Removes a server from the pending pings list when it is removed.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: Sends ping requests to all remaining servers, resets the pending list, and generates a new ping ID.
